routes.name: Visa-free entry
routes.summary: Citizens of the EU, US, UK, Canada, Japan, Australia and many others can enter without a visa for up to 90 days in 180. The official list is dated June 2023.

other: Official list is dated June 2023, so check for changes.
Wartime rules may limit entry. Confirm with a Ukrainian consulate before you travel.
Refugees and stateless persons always need a visa.

sources.label: MFA Ukraine: Entry regime for foreign citizens

routes.name: Electronic visa (e-Visa)
routes.summary: Online visa for citizens of eligible countries, single or double entry. Processed in 1 working day (urgent) or 3 working days.

other: Only for eligible countries, such as India, Thailand, Mexico, Philippines and South Africa per the entry list.
Wartime rules may limit entry. Confirm with a Ukrainian consulate before you travel.
Needs health insurance with 30,000 EUR cover and proof of funds.

routes.processing: 1 working day urgent, 3 working days regular.

sources.label: MFA Ukraine: Entry regime for foreign citizens

routes.name: Short-term visa (type C)
routes.summary: Single, double or multiple entry visa valid 6 months or the period in your supporting documents, up to 5 years. Apply at visa.mfa.gov.ua.

other: Passport valid 3+ months after departure and issued within 10 years
Funds for at least 20 days plus a 5-day reserve
Medical insurance of at least 30,000 EUR
Wartime rules may limit entry. Confirm with a Ukrainian consulate before you travel.

fees.label: UK consulate, regular service
fees.note: Doubled for expedited. Varies by passport and consulate.

sources.label: Embassy of Ukraine in the UK, visa requirements
MFA Ukraine: Entry regime for foreign citizens

routes.name: Transit visa
routes.summary: Single, double or multiple entry, up to 1 year. Each transit can last at most 5 days.

other: Wartime rules may limit entry. Confirm with a Ukrainian consulate before you travel.

sources.label: Embassy of Ukraine in the UK, visa requirements

routes.name: Long-term visa (type D)
routes.summary: Multiple entry, 90 days. It is the entry visa you need before applying for a temporary residence permit.

other: The residence permit page says a D visa is needed unless the law or a treaty says otherwise.

sources.label: Embassy of Ukraine in the UK, visa requirements
State Migration Service: temporary residence permit

routes.name: Temporary residence permit
routes.summary: Issued in Ukraine by the State Migration Service. Grounds include work, study, marriage or family of a Ukrainian citizen, foreign investment, volunteering and cultural or scientific programs. Usually valid 1 year and exchanged, not extended.

other: Work: permit to hire foreign workers or employment contract, permit valid for the contract term
Study: valid for the study period
Family: marriage to a Ukrainian citizen
Valid medical insurance policy needed
Apply at least 15 working days before your stay ends

stay.note: Exchanged rather than extended. Investor permit lasts 2 years.

routes.processing: Within 15 working days after documents are submitted.

sources.label: State Migration Service: temporary residence permit

routes.name: Temporary residence permit for investors
routes.summary: For founders, participants or beneficial owners of a Ukrainian company with a stake of at least 100,000 EUR in its authorized capital. The permit lasts 2 years.

investment.note: Share of authorized capital of a Ukrainian legal entity, at the National Bank rate on the investment date

other: Company must commit to tell the migration service if you stop being a founder or owner

routes.processing: Within 15 working days after documents are submitted.

sources.label: State Migration Service: temporary residence permit

routes.name: Immigration permit (permanent residence)
routes.summary: Permanent residence starts with an immigration permit. Most categories are under yearly quotas: skilled workers, science and culture, investors of at least 100,000 USD, siblings and grandparents of citizens, and army veterans. Spouses of 2+ years, children and parents of citizens, and some others are outside quotas.

investment.note: Foreign investment in Ukraine's economy, quota category

other: Spouse must be married over 2 years to a Ukrainian citizen (no quota)
Needs no serious criminal record, a medical certificate and a police certificate
Apply at a Ukrainian consulate abroad or at the migration service if legally in Ukraine

routes.processing: Up to one year. The permit is valid for one year once issued.

routes.name: Citizenship by admission
routes.summary: You need 5 years of continuous legal residence, an immigration permit, Ukrainian language skills, legal means of support and a pledge to give up other citizenship. Some exceptions exist.

other: 5 years of continuous legal residence
Immigration permit
Legal sources of income
Pledge to end foreign citizenship within 2 years of registration, or statelessness

citizenship.note: Applicants pledge to end foreign citizenship within 2 years. Passport is issued only after that.
